document.title: feat(cli): vitadeck dev watches, builds and uploads to a running Vita
document.summary: Adds `vitadeck dev <runtime-upload-url>`, which rebuilds the `.vdapp.zip` on every save and POSTs it to the Runtime Upload listener. It also adds `--help`, `--version`, and a non-empty-directory guard on `create`.
document.why: Authors had no edit-and-see loop on the Vita; [issue #51](source:s1) asks for a watch, build and upload command.

sources.title: vitadeck dev
sources.gist: Approved design: watch, rebuild with NODE_ENV=development, POST to /upload, print one line; --help, --version, create refuses non-empty dirs.

sources.label: PR #85
sources.gist: Implements #51 with a node:http stub test; no end-to-end run against the real listener.

lookFor: [#51](source:s1) lists `outDir`, `.vitadeck` and `node_modules` as ignored; the watcher also ignores `.git`, so commits and checkouts do not trigger uploads.
[#51](source:s1) reports a connection reset like a 409; the code also retries once after 500 ms before printing the busy line, which the issue does not ask for.
No end-to-end run against the native listener: [PR #85](source:s2) relies on the stub test and a raw TCP stub that truncates a 409.

groups.title: `vitadeck dev` loop
groups.why: The command [#51](source:s1) asks for: rebuild on save and upload to a running VitaDeck.
groups.summary: `dev` watches the project with recursive `fs.watch`, calls the in-process `build()` (which now returns its output paths), and `postArchive` turns each HTTP reply or socket error into one log line; `dev.test.ts` drives it against a `node:http` stub.
lookFor: `build()` no longer prints `Built …`/`Wrote …`; the `build` command in `main` prints them from the returned paths, so `vitadeck build` output is unchanged and `dev` stays at one line per cycle.
Subtle: `cycle()` reads `vitadeck.config.json` before `build()` so `outDir` is ignored before the first build writes to it; without that the first upload would trigger a second one.
A 409, `ECONNRESET`, `EPIPE` or `UND_ERR_SOCKET` all count as busy; a truncated reply body is swallowed and only the status is used.

groups.title: `--help`, `--version`, per-command flags, `create` guard
groups.summary: `main` short-circuits on `--help`/`--version`, validates flags against `COMMAND_FLAGS` per command, and `create` calls `isNonEmptyDir` unless `--force`; `cli.test.ts` checks each.
lookFor: Breaking: flags are now checked per command, so `vitadeck build --force` or `vitadeck create my-app --dev` now fail with `Unknown flag(s)` where they were silently accepted before.
Any argument starting with `-` is now a flag, and `-h`/`-v` win anywhere on the line: `vitadeck create -v` prints the version instead of scaffolding.

groups.title: Shared test fixtures
groups.why: Enables `dev.test.ts` and `cli.test.ts` to reuse the Deck App project fixture.
groups.summary: The project fixture and `execFileText` move verbatim from `package-format.test.ts` into `test-project.ts`, and `test:cli` runs `cli/*.test.ts`; the move is safe to skim.

groups.title: README and upload skill
groups.why: [#51](source:s1) asks for a "Develop on a Vita" README section and for the upload skill to point to `dev`.
groups.summary: The SDK README gains a "Develop on a Vita" section and a `create --force` line, and the `vitadeck-vdapp-upload` skill leads with `dev` and keeps the script and curl as the fallback.

commits.subject: feat(cli): vitadeck dev watches, builds and uploads to a running Vita
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
`vitadeck dev <runtime-upload-url>` builds like `build --dev`, POSTs the
.vdapp.zip to /upload as application/zip, prints one timestamped line per
upload, and repeats after 150 ms of quiet on any project change. Refused
connections point at the Shell Upload entry; 409 and early socket closes
retry once. Also adds --help, --version, and makes create refuse a
non-empty directory unless --force is passed.

Fixes #51

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
